newsitem.title: FRANCE: Five ships loading wheat in Rouen, six more due.
newsitem.headline: Five ships loading wheat in Rouen, six more due.

text.p: Five ships are loading a total of 83,000 tonnes of wheat at Rouen, port officials said on Tuesday.
The wheat is for export mostly to west Africa and Egypt, they said.
Six more ships are expected in port by March 22 to load around 120,000 tonnes of wheat. The destination was not specified.
One ship is also due in Rouen by March 22 to load 13,000 tonnes of barley for export to an unspecified destination.
